title: Virtual Compute: assisted review — ordinary reduction
content:
## Calculation basis

Virtual Compute assisted review — Choose no ordinary price reduction for an approved negotiated rate; otherwise choose spot price reduction fraction for spot, then the commitment price reduction fraction value for a commitment with a term other than none covering the entire interval, then campaign price reduction fraction for an eligible campaign on its supported original channel, then portfolio price reduction fraction if the narrowed period basis meets portfolio threshold inclusively, and zero otherwise; do not stack these ordinary price reductions.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for assisted review — ordinary reduction?**

Choose no ordinary price reduction for an approved negotiated rate; otherwise choose spot price reduction fraction for spot, then the commitment price reduction fraction value for a commitment with a term other than none covering the entire interval, then campaign price reduction fraction for an eligible campaign on its supported original channel, then portfolio price reduction fraction if the narrowed period basis meets portfolio threshold inclusively, and zero otherwise; do not stack these ordinary price reductions.

## Commitment reduction

The assisted review commitment reduction is 22% for one year and 38% for three years.

## Local hypothetical judgement

Hypothetically, an approved negotiated primary price applies. The ordinary price reduction is zero even if a campaign would otherwise qualify. If negotiated approval is absent and tenancy is spot, spot pricing takes the ordinary reduction position.
